idea-plugin.name: VSIX Publish Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Find the package.json lines that stop vsce before you run the release build

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → VSIX Publish Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/vsix-publish-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/vsix-publish-lint

action.text: VSIX Publish Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run VSIX Publish Lint on the file in the editor
